crebee-social-media-gatew v1.0.0

- Initial release of CreBee 社交媒体网关 skill.
- Enables unified API gateway access for automated management of 12 major Chinese social media platforms (Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, etc.).
- Supports content publishing (video/image/article), account management, data analysis, fan insights, and topic/music/activity search.
- Provides quickstart guides for authentication, API structure, supported content types, and pagination.
- Includes sample requests for batch publishing, publishing history queries, and task cancellation.
- Links to detailed platform-specific API documentation.
